plan_metadata.title: UI UX Enhancements and Bug Fixes
plan_metadata.author: gemini

_analysis_notes.summary: Fixes for UI layout issues, dark mode toggle, duplicate buttons, logo styling, and unnecessary scrolling as requested by the user.
important_constraints: Must adhere strictly to Angular and PrimeNG guidelines.
assumptions: The 'two buttons' refer to the Start Screening and See Workflow buttons in the hero section.
Dark mode issue is related to element class toggling or component usage.
Unnecessary scroll is due to width/height overflows on root layout.
risks: Layout adjustments might affect mobile view if not tested.

steps.title: Fix logo styling
steps.description: In `src/app/app.scss`, modify `.brand-mark__logo` to use `object-fit: contain`, remove hardcoded drop shadows, and adjust background to transparent if necessary so the logo integrates naturally.
steps.validation: Logo should appear without clipping or strange artifacts.

steps.title: Remove unnecessary scroll
steps.description: In `src/styles.scss`, add `overflow-x: hidden;` to `body` to prevent the fixed pseudo-elements (`::before`/`::after`) from causing horizontal scrolling. In `src/app/app.scss`, review `.app-shell` to ensure `min-height` and `padding-bottom` don't force a vertical scroll bar when content fits.
steps.validation: Window should not show scrollbars when content is shorter than viewport height/width.

steps.title: Refine items placement in Hero
steps.description: In `src/app/features/landing/landing.component.scss`, adjust `.showcase-float` positions to ensure they stay inside the container. Update media queries so elements do not overlap improperly on small screens.
steps.validation: Floating cards on the landing page hero image should not break layout across breakpoints.

steps.title: Remove duplicate function button
steps.description: In `src/app/features/landing/landing.component.html`, delete the 'See Workflow' button since its functionality is redundant and creates visual clutter alongside 'Start Screening'.
steps.validation: Only one primary call-to-action button should remain in the hero.

steps.title: Fix dark mode
steps.description: In `src/app/app.html`, change the theme toggle from a `<button pButton>` to a proper PrimeNG `<p-button>` component so `[label]` and `[icon]` bindings work correctly with the application state. Ensure PrimeNG is correctly picking up the state switch.
steps.validation: Clicking the dark mode button should visibly change the application theme.

steps.title: Enhance general Home Screen Aesthetics
steps.description: In `src/app/features/landing/landing.component.scss` and `styles.scss`, tweak gradient opacity, typography margins, and glass panel blur effects (`--glass-blur`) to create a more polished, premium look.
steps.validation: Hero section should feel premium, aligned, and aesthetically cohesive.
